title: An Herbal Enema Formula Alleviates Ulcerative Colitis by Inhibiting Enteric Glial Activation via the S100beta/RAGE/NF-kappaB Pathway.
authors: Li, Xue; Chen, Jianxin; Zhang, Xuya; Gao, Yushan; Fu, Yan; Jiang, Hong; Lu, Yi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药灌肠方通过S100beta/RAGE/NF-kappaB通路抑制肠胶质细胞活化缓解溃疡性结肠炎，仅涉及小分子与S100beta的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Activation of enteric glial cells (EGCs) contributes to the pathogenesis of ulcerative colitis (UC). This study examined whether Dibai Enema Liquid (DBE)-an herbal enema combining Sanguisorba officinalis, Bletilla striata, and Acacia catechu-modulates EGC-driven inflammation. LC-MS/MS profiles of DBE constituents and prioritized compounds were docked to S100beta. Efficacy was assessed in dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced murine colitis using body weight, colon length, histopathology, and cytokine levels (ELISA). Glial activation markers were measured by immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence colocalization, quantitative PCR (qPCR), and immunoblotting. An in vitro model used CRL-2690 enteric glia activated with lipopolysaccharide plus interferon-gamma, with DBE-containing rat serum (15%) as the intervention. Docking suggested a strong predicted binding of several DBE components to S100beta. DSS increased TNF-alpha and IL-1beta, disrupted tight junctions, and elevated S100beta/GFAP at both mRNA and protein levels, consistent with glial hyperactivation; DBE significantly reversed these changes. In vitro, DBE reduced S100beta, RAGE, iNOS (NOS2), and phosphorylated NF-kappaB p65. Collectively, DBE appears to alleviate UC by inhibiting EGC activation and downregulating the S100beta/RAGE/NF-kappaB/iNOS axis, thereby preserving mucosal integrity.
abstract_zh: 肠胶质细胞（EGCs）的活化参与溃疡性结肠炎（UC）的发病机制。本研究探讨了地柏灌肠液（DBE）——一种由地榆、白及和儿茶组成的草药灌肠剂——是否调节EGC驱动的炎症。通过LC-MS/MS分析DBE成分，并将优先化合物对接至S100beta。在葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的小鼠结肠炎中，通过体重、结肠长度、组织病理学和细胞因子水平（ELISA）评估疗效。胶质活化标志物通过免疫组织化学、免疫荧光共定位、定量PCR（qPCR）和免疫印迹法检测。体外模型使用脂多糖加干扰素-γ活化的CRL-2690肠胶质细胞，以含DBE的大鼠血清（15%）作为干预。对接结果显示，DBE的多种成分与S100beta有强预测结合。DSS增加了TNF-alpha和IL-1beta，破坏了紧密连接，并在mRNA和蛋白水平上升高了S100beta/GFAP，与胶质过度活化一致；DBE显著逆转了这些变化。在体外，DBE降低了S100beta、RAGE、iNOS（NOS2）和磷酸化NF-kappaB p65。总体而言，DBE似乎通过抑制EGC活化和下调S100beta/RAGE/NF-kappaB/iNOS轴来缓解UC，从而保护黏膜完整性。
